definitionZh: 中风-dashoffset CSS 属性定义了 SVG 元素相关破损阵列渲染的起点的偏移. 如果存在,它会超越元素的属性.
sourceDefinition: The stroke-dashoffset CSS property defines an offset for the starting point of the rendering of an SVG element's associated dash array. If present, it overrides the element's attribute.
